name: loop-on-issue
description: Unattended issue-to-PR pipeline for GitHub and GitLab: queue an issue, an agent claims it, develops it in its own worktree, and opens the change request.

plugins.name: loop-on-issue
plugins.description: Drain a labelled issue queue end to end — decompose requirements into executable issues, run one resumable agent session per issue, and submit the PR/MR. Works against GitHub via gh and GitLab via glab.
